content: Yakub Apomalapemo Pendua tee Esau
Wakutuu Yakub apatinda potontona tee atiliki, atiumbamo Esau aumba apoose 400 mia manga umane. Kasiimpomo abagemea manga anaana i tanga-tangana Lea, Rahel, tee i rua mia bhatua bhawine manga.
Incia adhikamea manga bhatua bhawine sumai tee manga anana i aroa, kasiimpo Lea tee manga anana, tee sapadhana incia sumai Rahel tee Yusuf i taliku mpuu.
Yakub samia alingka i aroana manga tee asuju ahoromati pitu mpearo, sampe incia apekakasu i akana.
Maka Esau abuntuli apokawaakamo Yakub, asakumea, asakulaka bhorokona tee aikia, kasiimpo apotangisimo manga incia.

Wakutuuna Esau apatinda potontona, akamatamea manga bhawine tee manga anana i aroana, aabhamo incia, "Incema buaka manga mia mopoosena tee ingkoo sii?" Alawani Yakub, "Manga anana mopadhana idhawuakana Aulataʼala i bhatuamu sii."
Kasiimpomo manga bhatua bhawine sumai tee manga anana apasari tee asuju ahoromati.
Lea tee manga anana uka apekakasumo, kasiimpo asuju ahoromati. Sapadhana sumai apekakasumo uka Yusuf tee Rahel, kasiimpomo asuju ahoromati uka.
Aabhamo Esau, "Opea haejatimu tee bhari-bharia gulumana kadhambaaka ipokawaakaku i saao?" Alawanimo Yakub, "Mamudhaakana opu umaasiaka bhatuamu."
Maka Esau apogaumo, "Andiku, iaku kukokadhaangiamo. Taroakamo opea modhaangiana i karomu sadhaadhaana amembali pewauamu."

Apogaumo Yakub, "Kuemani bholi mboo sumai. Ande opu satotuuna umaasiaka bhatuamu sii, tulungi tarimaia harataa idhawuakaku minaaka i limana bhatuamu sii. Satotuuna to iaku, kukamata rouna opu mboo mpuu kukamata rouna Aulataʼala. Opu upepagoakumo malape.
Kuemani tarimaia kadhawuna ibhawaakana i opu sii, roonamo Aulataʼala amalape incana i bhatuamu sabutuna iaku uka kukokadhaangia bhari-bharia sii." Yakub aemani mpuu, sampe Esau uka aunda atarimaia.
Pogaumo Esau, "Maimo ingkita tabhose tapalausaka lingkaata; bhekulingka kupoose tee ingkoo."

Maka Yakub apogau i incia, "Opuku umataua, manga anaana sii dhaangia amalute, tee uka manga gulumana bhembe dumba tee sapi dhaangiapo apadudua. Ande apasurua alingka tangkanamo saeomea, sumaimo bhari-bharia bhembe dumba sumai bheamate.

Jadi, taroakamo opuku ulingka uporikanaaka bhatuamu sii. Bhekujulu tee kupengkaanaka mboomo bhengkalana kadhambaaka modhaangiana i aroana bhatuamu apoose tee bhengkalana manga anaana, sampe kukawa i opuku i Seir."

Apogaumo Esau, "Ande mboo itu, taroakamo kubholiaka i ingkoo pia-pia mia minaaka i manga mia mopoosena tee iaku." Maka alawanimo Yakub, "Tarima kaasi, inda afaraluu opuku. Kumasanaa mpuu roonamo umaasiakaaku. Sumaimo podhomo itu."
Jadi ambulimo Esau i eo incia sumai uka aporope i Seir.
Maka Yakub abhose i Sukot. Iwe sumai incia apakaromo saangu bhanua to karona tee wale-wale to kadhambaakana. Siitumo sababuna tampa incia sumai asarongiakea Sukot.
I nuncana lingkaana minaaka i Mesopotamia, Yakub akawamo tee salaamati i Sikhem, i Tana Kanaan, kasiimpo incia apakaro kemana i saripina kota sumai.
Kasiimpomo aalimo satidha tana, tampana incia apakaro kemana tee haragaana 100 tibha doi pera minaaka i siwuluna Hemor, o amana Sikhem.
Incia apakaromo saangu tampa tunuana kurubani tee asarongiakamea, "El Elohe Israel," mokomaʼanana "Aulataʼala dhaangiamo Aulataʼalana Israel."

footnotes.text: Sukot: Saro incia sii i nuncana pogau Ibrani akomaʼana "tampa peulusa."
